sympy.A1_note: the law's own (rho_ph, Phi_law) fix the phase-space phantom f_ph = A exp(-E/T) with T = V_f^2/2 and its amplitude; no temperature is inserted. Input level: the same rho_ph class A already takes.
sympy.A3_two_way: M is symmetric PSD with M dE = 0; dS/dt is a sum of squares for any state, hot or cold, so the partner may give energy (cold matter, <v^2> < 3T) or take it (hot matter): two-way exchange is allowed by M
sympy.A0_note: Casimir entropy + partner: stationary iff C'(f) is the same in every velocity cell -> f uniform in v (C strictly convex), not normalisable on unbounded v: no finite temperature (T -> infinity), energy flows from phi into matter without bound. Without the partner (energy-conserving Landau pairs) the equilibrium is the Maxwellian at the local kinetic temperature: a cold (sigma = 0) element is already stationary -> T stays at the source value 0.
sympy.A5_phase_space_KL_note: d/dt int f ln(f/f_ph)|Vlasov = -int f (F'/F) v.grad(Phi_law - Phi): vanishes only where the real potential equals the law's (psi = Phi_law - Phi = 0)

A5_other_candidates.E_N + Casimirs (incl. E_N - T S_B): Vlasov-invariant; drift rate -alpha int rho tau grad psi.grad Phi (indefinite, CFG544) and the relaxation heats cold matter (dE_N > 0): not monotone
A5_other_candidates.F + c F_v (c >= 0): Vlasov rate int rho u.grad psi + c(...) first order in u, dissipation O(alpha): fails for small alpha
A5_other_candidates.phase-space KL to f_ph: Vlasov rate vanishes only where Phi = Phi_law (identity above)

sympy.A6_note: the relaxation pulls each bin's mean velocity to zero in the region's baryon frame: total j decays at alpha/tau unless already zero, and the stochastic kicks change each element's j: NOT CONSERVED. A reference centred on the local mean velocity would conserve momentum (d<v>/dt = 0) but was not frozen and is not run.
sympy.A7_note: the velocity relaxation acts at fixed x (an ODE in v per point): no spatial propagation, no new speed; alpha keeps only CFG542's stability bound (alpha beta q < 1)
